#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007LL;

// Reader equivalent
string readString() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    return s;
}

// Sorting functions (not used in main but kept for completeness)
void sortArray(ll arr[], int n) {
    sort(arr, arr+n);
}
void sortArray(int arr[], int n) {
    sort(arr, arr+n);
}
void sortArray(char arr[], int n) {
    sort(arr, arr+n);
}

// Mod operations
ll mod_mul(ll a, ll b) { return (a % MOD) * (b % MOD) % MOD; }
ll mod_sum(ll a, ll b) { return (a + b) % MOD; }

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    while (b) {
        a %= b;
        swap(a, b);
    }
    return a;
}

ll power(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    ll res = 1;
    x %= m;
    while (y) {
        if (y & 1) res = res * x % m;
        x = x * x % m;
        y >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll modInverse(ll a, ll m) {
    return power(a, m-2, m);
}

ll lcm(ll a, ll b) {
    return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
}

// Prime sieve (not used)
vector<bool> prime(int num) {
    vector<bool> boolv(num, true);
    for (int i=2; i*i<num; i++) {
        if (boolv[i]) {
            for (int j=i*i; j<num; j+=i) boolv[j] = false;
        }
    }
    if (num>=0) {
        if (num>0) boolv[0]=false;
        if (num>1) boolv[1]=false;
    }
    return boolv;
}

// Combinations class (not used)
class Combinations {
public:
    vector<ll> z, z1, z2;
    ll mod;
    Combinations(ll N, ll mod) : mod(mod) {
        z.resize(N+1); z1.resize(N+1); z2.resize(N+1);
        z[0]=1;
        for (int i=1; i<=N; i++) z[i]=z[i-1]*i%mod;
        z2[0]=z2[1]=1;
        for (int i=2; i<=N; i++) z2[i]=z2[mod%i]*(mod-mod/i)%mod;
        z1[0]=z1[1]=1;
        for (int i=2; i<=N; i++) z1[i]=z2[i]*z1[i-1]%mod;
    }
    ll fac(ll n) { return z[(int)n]; }
    ll invrsNum(ll n) { return z2[(int)n]; }
    ll invrsFac(ll n) { return z1[(int)n]; }
    ll ncr(ll N, ll R) {
        if (R<0 || R>N) return 0;
        return z[(int)N] * z1[(int)R] % mod * z1[(int)(N-R)] % mod;
    }
};

// DisjointSet (not used)
class DisjointUnionSets {
public:
    vector<int> rank, parent;
    int n;
    DisjointUnionSets(int n) : n(n) {
        rank.resize(n);
        parent.resize(n);
        makeSet();
    }
    void makeSet() {
        for (int i=0; i<n; i++) parent[i]=i;
    }
    int find(int x) {
        if (parent[x]!=x) parent[x]=find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }
    void unionSet(int x, int y) {
        int xRoot=find(x), yRoot=find(y);
        if (xRoot==yRoot) return;
        if (rank[xRoot]<rank[yRoot]) parent[xRoot]=yRoot;
        else if (rank[yRoot]<rank[xRoot]) parent[yRoot]=xRoot;
        else { parent[yRoot]=xRoot; rank[xRoot]++; }
    }
};

// SparseTable (not used)
class SparseTable {
public:
    vector<vector<ll>> st;
    vector<int> log;
    SparseTable(vector<ll>& arr) {
        int n=arr.size();
        st.assign(n, vector<ll>(25));
        log.assign(n+2, 0);
        build_log(n+1);
        build(arr);
    }
    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1]=0;
        for (int i=2; i<=n; i++) log[i]=log[i/2]+1;
    }
    void build(vector<ll>& arr) {
        int n=arr.size();
        for (int i=n-1; i>=0; i--) {
            for (int j=0; j<25; j++) {
                int r=i+(1<<j)-1;
                if (r>=n) break;
                if (j==0) st[i][j]=arr[i];
                else st[i][j]=min(st[i][j-1], st[i+(1<<(j-1))][j-1]);
            }
        }
    }
    ll query(int l, int r) {
        int w=r-l+1;
        int p=log[w];
        return min(st[l][p], st[r-(1<<p)+1][p]);
    }
};

// KMP (not used)
vector<int> KMP(string str) {
    int n=str.length();
    vector<int> kmp(n);
    for (int i=1; i<n; i++) {
        int j=kmp[i-1];
        while (j>0 && str[i]!=str[j]) j=kmp[j-1];
        if (str[i]==str[j]) j++;
        kmp[i]=j;
    }
    return kmp;
}

// Global variables used in back() and TEST_CASE
bool flag;

bool fnc(const string& s, int i) {
    return s[i] != '_';
}

ll back(string arr) {
    ll tot=0;
    int n=arr.length();
    if (fnc(arr, n-1) && fnc(arr, n-2)) {
        ll num = (arr[n-2]-'0')*10 + (arr[n-1]-'0');
        if (num%25==0) {
            if (num==0) flag=true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else if (arr[n-1]=='_' && arr[n-2]=='_') {
        flag=true;
        return 4;
    } else if (arr[n-1]=='_') {
        char c = arr[n-2];
        if (c=='2' || c=='0' || c=='7' || c=='5') {
            if (c=='0') flag=true;
            return 1;
        } else return 0;
    } else {
        char c = arr[n-1];
        if (c=='0' || c=='5') {
            if (c=='0') flag=true;
            return 2;
        } else return 0;
    }
}

void TEST_CASE() {
    string s = readString();
    int n = s.length();
    if (n==1) {
        if (s[0]=='0' || s[0]=='_' || s[0]=='X') cout << 1 << "\n";
        else cout << 0 << "\n";
        return;
    }
    if (s[0]=='0') {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return;
    }
    bool hasX = false;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (c=='X') { hasX=true; break; }
    }
    ll tot=0;
    if (hasX) {
        for (int i=0; i<10; i++) {
            string temp = s;
            if (temp[0]=='X' && i==0) continue;
            for (int j=0; j<n; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='X') temp[j] = (char)('0'+i);
            }
            flag=false;
            ll backVal = back(temp);
            ll pre=1;
            for (int j=0; j<n-2; j++) {
                if (temp[j]=='_') {
                    if (j==0) pre*=9;
                    else pre*=10;
                }
            }
            tot += pre * backVal;
            if (pre==1 && flag) tot--;
        }
    } else {
        flag=false;
        ll backVal = back(s);
        ll pre=1;
        for (int j=0; j<n-2; j++) {
            if (s[j]=='_') {
                if (j==0) pre*=9;
                else pre*=10;
            }
        }
        tot += pre * backVal;
        if (pre==1 && flag) tot--;
    }
    cout << tot << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int tc = 1;
    // tc = readInt(); // if needed
    for (int i=1; i<=tc; i++) {
        TEST_CASE();
    }
    return 0;
}
